functions.recoveredRole: Moves the selected Add Watch current item down by one position in stored and visible order
functions.behavior: Reads lbCurrent.ItemIndex and the private current-items count. When the index is before the last row, it exchanges that index with the next index in the private TStringList and then in lbCurrent.Items. The VCL visible-list exchange changes ItemIndex to the new row, so the moved logical item stays selected at i + 1. A last-row selection is a no-op; a missing selection with a non-empty list passes the upper-bound-only guard and supplies -1 to the first VCL exchange.
functions.evidence: The DFM binds AddWatch.sbMoveDown.OnClick to 00f86070 and supplies the Move Down hint and downward two-frame glyph. The handler reads ItemIndex from form field +0x6b0, reads +0x710 Count, tests index < count - 1, and dispatches Exchange(index, index + 1) first on +0x710 and then on +0x6b0.Items. FormCreate constructs +0x710, FormShow copies it to lbCurrent.Items, and the Add and Delete handlers update both objects. Recovered VCL target FUN_0068acb0 swaps the visible string and item-data pairs and changes ItemIndex from the old exchanged position to the new position.
